description: Change a character's stress outside a roll: add it (a number or dice, e.g. "1d10"), relieve it (never below the character's minimum), or raise or lower the minimum. Use it when the fiction or a table says to gain stress or change minimum stress; a failed roll_test already adds stress in worlds where stress is a penalty.

ability.description: Where stress past the max goes, in worlds whose stressConfig.overflow is "reduce_ability": the most relevant ability. Without it, overflow is reported for you to apply.

amount.description: Stress to add (negative relieves it): a whole number, or dice to roll such as "1d10" or "-1d6". Relief never goes below the character's minimum.

minimum.description: Change to the character's minimum stress, e.g. 1 to raise it by one. Stress below the new minimum rises to it.

reason.description: What caused the change, for the log

name: adjust_stress
